# Gambit

> Waffle-cut plantain chips from Two Plantain Bros. Tagline: “Waffle cut. One chip and you'll get it.”

Gambit makes golden, savory, and sweet waffle-cut plantain chips in three flavors: Salt, BBQ, and Churro. Sold in bags (solo) and cases of six with free shipping in the continental U.S. As of site launch, every flavor is sold out; visitors can join a waitlist (name + phone).

## Canonical site

- Homepage: https://gambitchips.com/
- Extended AI context: https://gambitchips.com/llms-full.txt
- Sitemap: https://gambitchips.com/sitemap.xml

## Products

- Salt (classic sea salt): https://gambitchips.com/flavors/salt/
- BBQ (smoky sweet, in-house rub): https://gambitchips.com/flavors/bbq/
- Churro (cinnamon sugar): https://gambitchips.com/flavors/churro/

## Pricing (USD)

- Single bag: $11.25
- Case of 6: $36 (free shipping)
